The `auto-merge` run waits, and doesn't approve, until all four of these hold: (1) CI is green; (2) no review thread is open; (3) Lore's review stands approved on the PR's current head; (4) the PR has been open for the minimum age, `auto_merge.min_age_hours`, which is 24 hours by default. Red CI, a conflict or an open review thread is sent to the `auto-merge-fix` agent, which makes at most three rounds. A later change (commit 1731e90) removed the fixer's job of merging the base in and editing any author's branch. After it, auto merge only waits and approves, and the loop that opened a PR keeps it mergeable. A PR that is only waiting out its age shows as 'Awaiting merge', with the label 'merges after …'.

Lore's own PRs are parked, not approved, when the lore-reviewer App isn't installed. Without it, Lore's own App is the approver, and GitHub refuses an approval from the PR's author. Drafts, forks and PRs that a run is already working are skipped. After approval, if the PR touches a CODEOWNERS path and its branch has no approval rule, the loop does not merge it itself.
